frameSizePolicy: Lossless crops of approved source atlases plus transparent padding. Documented prior downsample repairs are marked per frame; no interpolated upscaling or fixed pixel grid.
pixelsPerUnitPolicy: Per-direction standing-height calibration preserves prior physical size; custom pivots preserve source bottom/ground offsets, including jump elevation, and horizontal head registration.
